geography: Late Jurassic lithographic limestones of Bavaria, Germany
overview: Archaeopteryx is a Late Jurassic avialan, a member of the bird-line dinosaurs, known from a small series of Bavarian fossils. The cited analyses place it outside Neornithes, the crown group of living birds; the fossils are not presented as direct ancestors of modern birds.
overviewZh: Archaeopteryx 是晚侏罗世的鸟翼类，属于鸟类一侧的恐龙支系，目前由巴伐利亚少量化石代表。所引分析把它放在新鸟类之外；新鸟类是现生鸟类构成的冠群。这里记录的是化石与系统分析的关系，不是现代鸟类的已知直系祖先。

ecology.diet: The cited flight and systematic studies do not resolve diet.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from carbonate settings of the Solnhofen archipelago, represented by Bavarian lithographic limestones.
ecology.locomotion: The skeleton supports terrestrial and aerial capacities. Flight style is inferred from bone geometry rather than observed.
ecology.bodySize: The cited specimens are small-bodied paravians.
ecology.guild: The cited material does not establish one feeding guild.
ecology.dietZh: 所引飞行和系统学研究未能确定食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自索伦霍芬群岛的碳酸盐沉积环境，以巴伐利亚石灰华板岩为代表。
ecology.locomotionZh: 骨骼支持其具备地面活动和空中活动能力。其飞行方式是根据骨骼几何形态推断的，而非直接观察所得。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所引标本为小型近鸟类。
ecology.guildZh: 所引材料无法确定其属于哪一种摄食生态类群。

traits: Asymmetrical flight feathers occur with skeletal fossils
Toothed jaws and a long bony tail
Pectoral geometry is compatible with short-burst active flight in one biomechanical comparison
evidenceSummary: The oldest referred specimen extends the recorded genus range into the earliest Tithonian Painten Formation and documents anatomical variation. Synchrotron comparison supports active-flight capacity, not the performance of living crown birds.
evidenceSummaryZh: 目前归入该属的最早标本，把记录范围延伸到 Painten 组最早的提通期，并显示了解剖差异。同步辐射比较支持主动飞行能力的解释，但不能代表现生鸟类冠群的飞行表现。

title.en: What do the Bavarian fossils show about flight?
title.zh: 巴伐利亚化石对飞行能力说明什么？

text.en: Archaeopteryx is a Late Jurassic avialan, a member of the bird-line dinosaurs, known from a small series of Bavarian fossils. The cited analyses place it outside Neornithes, the crown group of living birds; the fossils are not presented as direct ancestors of modern birds.
text.zh: Archaeopteryx 是晚侏罗世的鸟翼类，属于鸟类一侧的恐龙支系，目前由巴伐利亚少量化石代表。所引分析把它放在新鸟类之外；新鸟类是现生鸟类构成的冠群。这里记录的是化石与系统分析的关系，不是现代鸟类的已知直系祖先。

title.en: Feathers accompany distinctive skeletal anatomy
title.zh: 羽毛与独特的骨骼解剖共同保存

text.en: Referred fossils are small-bodied paravians preserving asymmetrical flight feathers alongside toothed jaws and a long bony tail. The specimens show substantial anatomical variation; they do not demonstrate Archaeopteryx as the direct ancestor of living birds.
text.zh: 归入的化石是小型近鸟类，保存了不对称飞羽，同时具有带齿的颌骨和细长的骨质尾部。标本显示显著的解剖差异；它们不能证明始祖鸟是现生鸟类的直接祖先。

title.en: Wing geometry supports a bounded flight inference
title.zh: 翼部几何特征支持有限范围内的飞行推断

text.en: Synchrotron analyses found wing-bone geometry compatible with short-burst active flight in the tested comparison, supporting aerial capacity; this is a bounded model result, not observed behaviour or endurance. The skeletal record also supports terrestrial capacity, but this comparison does not measure how Archaeopteryx moved on land.
text.zh: 同步辐射分析发现，在所测试的比较模型中，翼骨几何形态与短时主动飞行相容，支持其具有空中活动能力。这是受模型条件限定的结果，不是对实际行为或耐力的观察。骨骼记录也支持其具备陆地活动能力，但该比较并未测量始祖鸟在陆地上的运动方式。

title.en: The oldest specimen of Archaeopteryx
title.zh: The oldest specimen of Archaeopteryx

scope.en: Rauhut et al. (2018), geological setting, systematic palaeontology, specimen descriptions (Figures 1?32) and Table 1: Bavarian material, anatomy, variation and the referred Painten specimen.

title.en: Wing bone geometry reveals active flight in Archaeopteryx
title.zh: Wing bone geometry reveals active flight in Archaeopteryx

scope.en: Voeten et al. (2018), Figures 1?4 and Supplementary Data 1?2: comparative wing-bone geometry and the short-burst active-flight interpretation.

readerLimitations.en: The described sample comes from Bavarian lithographic limestones in the Solnhofen archipelago. That depositional setting does not establish daily habitat; the cited work does not resolve diet or a feeding guild, and the flight model is not a performance measure for crown birds.
readerLimitations.zh: 所述样本来自索伦霍芬群岛的巴伐利亚石灰岩。该沉积环境不能证明日常栖息地；所引研究未确定食性或完整取食类群，飞行模型也不衡量今鸟类的飞行表现。

traitsZh: 骨骼化石伴有不对称的飞羽。
有齿的颌部和长长的骨质尾巴。
在一项生物力学比较中，胸带结构几何形态与短时主动飞行相符。

geography: Antarctica and Europe for the two Maastrichtian fossil tests highlighted here
overview: Neornithes is the crown group of living birds, defined by their common ancestor and all descendants. Whether particular Cretaceous fossils belong inside that boundary depends on explicit phylogenetic analyses, and one fossil cannot define the ecology of all crown birds.

ecology.diet: There is no single crown-wide diet. The Vegavis skull supports underwater prey capture only for that fossil.
ecology.habitat: Global across marine, freshwater and terrestrial environments today
ecology.locomotion: Predominantly volant, with multiple independently flight-reduced or flightless lineages
ecology.dietZh: 冠群没有单一的共同食性。Vegavis 头骨仅支持对该化石所代表个体具有水下捕食能力的判断。

traits: Crown membership is defined relationally, not by one universally diagnostic fossil character
Vegavis skull anatomy combines an avian beak and crown-like neuroanatomy with a specialized feeding apparatus
Asteriornis preserves a different late Maastrichtian galloanseran character combination
evidenceSummary: A 2025 skull analysis supports placing Vegavis within crown waterfowl, but earlier studies gave it other positions. Asteriornis also moves among near-crown placements under different analyses, so the oldest highlighted crown-bird age depends on which topology is accepted.

title.en: A crown group is defined from living birds
title.zh: 冠群由现生鸟类定义

text.en: Neornithes includes the most recent common ancestor of all living birds and every descendant of that ancestor. Archaeopteryx falls outside this crown boundary. There is no single fossil feature that defines every crown bird, so Cretaceous candidates such as Vegavis and Asteriornis must be tested in explicit phylogenetic analyses rather than assigned by age or resemblance alone.
text.zh: 今鸟类包含所有现生鸟类最近的共同祖先，以及该祖先的全部后代。始祖鸟位于这个冠群边界之外。没有一种化石特征能单独定义全部冠群鸟类，因此 Vegavis 和 Asteriornis 等白垩纪候选者必须通过明确的系统发育分析检验，不能只依据年代或相似外形归入其中。

title.en: Cretaceous skulls test the boundary in different ways
title.zh: 白垩纪头骨以不同方式检验这一边界

text.en: The Antarctic fossil Vegavis AMNH FARB 30899 dates to 69.2–68.4 million years ago. A 2025 analysis of its nearly complete skull supports crown-waterfowl affinity, while earlier studies recorded conflicting placements. The European Asteriornis holotype NHMM 2013 008 is younger, at 66.8–66.7 million years ago, and parsimony and tip-dated Bayesian analyses place it differently. The 69.2 Ma crown-bird minimum in this account therefore depends on accepting the 2025 placement of Vegavis; the two fossils do not map a complete Cretaceous range or an origin area.
text.zh: 南极洲的 Vegavis 标本 AMNH FARB 30899 年代为 6920–6840 万年前。2025 年对其近完整头骨的分析支持它属于冠群水禽，但较早研究曾提出互相冲突的位置。欧洲 Asteriornis 正模 NHMM 2013 008 年代较晚，为 6680–6670 万年前；简约法与尖端定年贝叶斯分析对其位置也有不同结果。因此，本档案中 6920 万年前的冠群鸟类化石下限取决于是否接受 2025 年对 Vegavis 的归属；这两件化石并不能绘出完整白垩纪分布或起源区域。

title.en: One fossil cannot define the ecology of all birds
title.zh: 一种化石不能代表所有鸟类的生态

text.en: The crown group includes birds with varied diets and habitats, so it has no single ecological guild. Vegavis preserves a narrow beak, an enlarged jaw-muscle attachment area and other skull features used to infer underwater prey capture. That functional interpretation applies to Vegavis alone; it is not evidence that all early or living crown birds shared the same feeding mode.
text.zh: 冠群鸟类的食性和栖息环境多样，不能归入单一生态类群。Vegavis 保存了狭窄的喙、较大的颌肌附着区等头骨特征，研究者据此推断它可能在水下捕食；这一功能解释只适用于 Vegavis，不能证明早期或现生冠群鸟类都采用相同取食方式。

title.en: Torres et al. (2025), Antarctic bird skull
title.zh: Torres 等（2025），南极鸟类头骨

scope.en: AMNH FARB 30899, its 69.2–68.4 Ma age statement, skull description and combined phylogenetic analyses, Figures 1–4. The source supports crown-waterfowl affinity in the 2025 matrix while documenting earlier placements; it does not make that placement historically uncontested.
scope.zh: AMNH FARB 30899、其 69.2–68.4 Ma 年代陈述、头骨描述与组合系统发育分析、图 1–4。该来源支持 2025 年矩阵中的冠群水禽位置，同时记录较早的其他归属；这一位置并非历来无争议。

title.en: Field et al. (2020), European crown-bird candidate
title.zh: Field 等（2020），欧洲冠群鸟类候选者

scope.en: NHMM 2013 008, its Maastrichtian geological setting and Figures 1–4, including the parsimony and tip-dated analyses. The placement differs between analyses; the source does not establish an undisputed crown position or complete fossil range.
scope.zh: NHMM 2013 008、马斯特里赫特期地质背景与图 1–4，包括简约法和尖端定年分析。不同分析给出不同位置；该来源不能确立无争议的冠群归属或完整化石延限。

overviewZh: Neornithes 是现生鸟类的冠群，定义为其最近共同祖先及其全部后代。某些白垩纪化石是否属于这一范围，取决于明确的系统发育分析；一件化石无法界定所有鸟类冠群成员的生态。
evidenceSummaryZh: 一项 2025 年的头骨分析支持将 Vegavis 置于冠群水鸟之内，但早期研究曾提出其他位置。不同分析对 Asteriornis 的近冠群位置也有不同结果，因此突出展示的最早冠群鸟类年代取决于所接受的系统树拓扑。

geography: Pekin Formation, Chatham County, North Carolina, United States
overview: The immature, partial skeleton NCSM 21558 anchors Carnufex in the Carnian Pekin Formation of North Carolina. Its serrated teeth and reconstructed size led the cited study to interpret it as a large terrestrial predator in that fossil assemblage; those ecological and body-size claims are inferences, not observed behaviour.

ecology.diet: Serrated, recurved teeth support a faunivorous interpretation; the fossil does not preserve feeding.
ecology.habitat: The study treats Carnufex as terrestrial within the sampled Pekin Formation assemblage.
ecology.locomotion: The study treats it as terrestrial, but its bones do not directly record locomotor performance.
ecology.bodySize: About 3 m in the study's reconstruction; the estimate relies on an immature femur and incomplete skull material.
ecology.guild: The study interprets it as a top-tier terrestrial predator in the sampled Pekin Formation community.
ecology.dietZh: 带锯齿的弯曲牙齿支持其食动物的解释；化石未保存摄食行为。
ecology.habitatZh: 该研究认为 Carnufex 在所取样的 Pekin 组化石组合中为陆生动物。
ecology.locomotionZh: 研究将其视为陆生动物，但骨骼并未直接记录运动表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 研究重建估计约 3 米；该估计依据一根未成熟个体的股骨和不完整头骨材料。
ecology.guildZh: 该研究将其解释为所取样 Pekin 组生物群中的高阶陆生捕食者。

traits: NCSM 21558 preserves parts of the skull, vertebral column, ribs and left humerus
The reconstructed skull is slender and ornamented, with an estimated length greater than 50 cm
Premaxillary teeth are elongate, serrated and slightly recurved
evidenceSummary: The holotype anatomy and its approximately 231-million-year-old Pekin Formation context are documented. The study's body-size, predator-role and basal crocodylomorph interpretations depend on comparisons and an incomplete, immature specimen.

title.en: What the partial skeleton preserves
title.zh: 部分骨骼保存了什么？

text.en: The holotype NCSM 21558 preserves parts of the skull, vertebral column, ribs and left humerus; a separate referred humerus is NCSM 21623. The reconstructed skull is slender and ornamented, with an estimated length greater than 50 cm. Its premaxillary teeth are long, serrated and slightly recurved. Because the holotype was still growing and is incomplete, these observations do not describe every Carnufex individual or adult body proportions.
text.zh: 正模 NCSM 21558 保存了部分头骨、脊柱、肋骨和左肱骨；另有一件归入的肱骨编号为 NCSM 21623。复原的头骨细长并带有装饰，估计长度超过 50 厘米；前颌齿较长、具锯齿且略向后弯。正模仍未成年且保存不完整，因此这些观察不能代表每只卡罗莱纳屠夫鳄或成年个体的全部体型比例。

title.en: How the study inferred a large predator
title.zh: 研究者如何推断它是大型捕食者？

text.en: The cited analysis estimated a body length of about 3 m using the reconstructed skull and an immature femur-length estimate of 354–441 mm. It placed Carnufex near the base of Crocodylomorpha in an unresolved polytomy in a matrix of 79 taxa and 413 characters. The same study interpreted it as a top-tier terrestrial predator in the Pekin Formation community. Length, branch position and ecological role are model-based conclusions from the sampled material, not direct evidence of adult size, behaviour or ancestry.
text.zh: 所引分析依据复原头骨和未成年个体的股骨长度估计（354–441 毫米），推算体长约 3 米。研究用包含 79 个类群、413 个性状的矩阵，将卡罗莱纳屠夫鳄置于鳄形类基部的未解析多分叉中；同一研究还把它解释为佩金组动物群中的顶级陆生捕食者。体长、分支位置和生态角色都是基于样本的分析结论，并非对成年体型、行为或祖先关系的直接观察。

title.en: Zanno et al. (2015), Carnufex anatomy and predator interpretation
title.zh: Zanno 等（2015），Carnufex 解剖与捕食者解释

scope.en: Holotype NCSM 21558, referred humerus NCSM 21623, Pekin Formation occurrence and the 79-taxon, 413-character analysis; Article 9276, Figures 1–2 and Supplementary Figure S9. The study's length, predator-guild and basal-placement conclusions remain bounded to this incomplete, skeletally immature sample and its matrix.
scope.zh: 正模 NCSM 21558、归入的肱骨 NCSM 21623、佩金组出现记录及 79 类群、413 性状分析；文章 9276、图 1–2 和补充图 S9。体长、捕食者功能群和基部位置等结论仍限于这件未成年且不完整的样本及其矩阵。

overviewZh: 不成熟且不完整的骨架 NCSM 21558，将 Carnufex 定位于北卡罗来纳州卡尼期 Pekin 组。该化石组合中，其锯齿状牙齿和重建体型使所引研究将其解释为大型陆生捕食者；这些生态和体型判断是推断，并非观察到的行为。
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模的解剖结构及其约 231 Ma 的 Pekin 组地层背景均有记录。研究对体型、捕食者角色和基干鳄形类位置的解释，取决于比较结果以及这件不完整、未成熟的标本。

overview: The latest Maastrichtian bird Asteriornis maastrichtensis is anchored by the CT-imaged holotype NHMM 2013 008, a nearly complete three-dimensional skull with fragmentary postcranial bones. Published analyses place it near crown Galloanserae but differ on its precise position.

ecology.diet: Not resolved by the cited description
ecology.habitat: A possible littoral ecology inferred from the marine depositional context, not a directly observed habitat preference
ecology.locomotion: Not resolved by the cited description
ecology.bodySize: Mean body-mass estimate of 394 g from the study's skeletal scaling model
ecology.guild: No feeding or locomotor guild is assigned from the cited evidence

traits: A nearly complete, three-dimensionally preserved skull is associated with fragmentary postcranial elements
The skull combines galliform-like and anseriform-like features in the authors' comparison
Parsimony and tip-dated Bayesian analyses recover different near-galloanseran positions
evidenceSummary: The 66.8–66.7 Ma horizon, skull anatomy and 394 g body-mass estimate are tied to a named specimen and a scaling model. Exact branch placement and possible littoral ecology remain interpretations.

title.en: A genus introduced through its type specimen
title.zh: 从模式标本认识一个属

text.en: This route introduces genus Asteriornis through NHMM 2013 008, the holotype of A. maastrichtensis. It comes from the Maastricht Formation at Belgium’s CBR-Romontbos quarry; the cited 2020 study constrains its horizon to 66.8–66.7 Ma. CT imaging reveals a nearly complete three-dimensional skull and associated postcranial bones. This named fossil is the starting material, rather than a complete sample of variation across the genus.
text.zh: Asteriornis 属在本阅读路径中由 A. maastrichtensis 的正模 NHMM 2013 008 引入。材料来自比利时 CBR-Romontbos 采石场的 Maastricht 组，所引2020年研究将层位限定为6680万至6670万年前。CT 成像揭示近完整三维头骨及相关头后骨骼；这里阅读的是具名化石材料，不是整个属的完整变异样本。

title.en: Follow anatomy, relationships and inference limits
title.zh: 沿解剖、亲缘关系与解释边界继续阅读

text.en: Continue to the Asteriornis maastrichtensis species page: distinguish preserved cranial features from the authors’ landfowl and waterfowl comparisons, then compare the parsimony and tip-dated Bayesian placements. The 394-g body mass is a skeletal-scaling estimate; littoral ecology is a tentative depositional-context interpretation. The occurrence age establishes neither a global crown-bird first appearance nor direct ancestry.
text.zh: 接着读 Asteriornis maastrichtensis 的种级页：先区分保存下来的头骨特征与作者的鸡形类、雁形类比较，再看简约法与尖端定年贝叶斯分析为何给出不同位置。体重394克来自骨骼尺度估计；滨岸生态只是沉积背景所支持的可能解释。标本出现的年龄不能替代冠群鸟类全球首现，也不确立直接祖先关系。

overviewZh: 最晚马斯特里赫特期的鸟类 Asteriornis maastrichtensis 以经 CT 成像的正模 NHMM 2013 008 为主要依据。该标本包括一具近乎完整的三维头骨和零碎的颅后骨骼。已发表的分析将其置于冠群鸡雁类附近，但对其确切位置的判断不一。
evidenceSummaryZh: 66.8–66.7 Ma 地层层位、头骨解剖特征及 394 克体重估计，均对应到具名标本和体尺换算模型。确切的支系位置及可能的滨岸生态仍属解释。

title.en: Field et al. (2020), Asteriornis holotype anatomy and competing phylogenetic analyses
title.zh: Field 等（2020），Asteriornis 正模解剖与竞争系统发育分析

scope.en: NHMM 2013 008 and its quarry/horizon provenance; Figures 1–3, Extended Data Figures 7–9 and the cited description. Existing research claims delimit anatomy, competing topology results, the skeletal-scaling mass estimate and tentative littoral interpretation. These locators do not establish a complete global range, feeding behaviour, flight performance, direct ancestry of this guide.
scope.zh: NHMM 2013 008 及其采石场和层位来源；图1–3、扩展数据图7–9及所引描述。既有研究 claims 限定解剖观察、竞争拓扑、骨骼尺度体重估计和暂定滨岸解释。这些定位不确立完整全球分布、取食行为、飞行性能、直系祖先关系。

readerLimitations.en: This genus route is limited to a named holotype and its cited study, without a complete genus range, ecology or variation account. The route’s 66.8–66.7 Ma interval applies to the cited sample; a global species range and first and last appearances remain unresolved. Recorded database placement and atlas navigation do not independently resolve competing phylogenetic results. This bilingual guide.
readerLimitations.zh: 这是单一具名正模及其所引研究的属级阅读入口，不能外推完整属级分布、生态或种内变异。本阅读路径中的6680万至6670万年前限定到已有样本，不表示已经证实全球首现与末现；种级整体范围仍缺少充分来源。数据库所录分类位置与图谱导航不能独立解决不同分析间的分支差异。。

geography: Pekin Formation, Chatham County, North Carolina, United States
overview: Carnufex carolinensis is represented by the partial, skeletally immature holotype NCSM 21558 and a referred humerus, NCSM 21623. The study reconstructs an animal about 3 m long and places it among higher-tier terrestrial predators of the Pekin Formation assemblage.

ecology.diet: Faunivory is inferred from serrated, recurved teeth rather than directly observed feeding
ecology.habitat: Terrestrial Pekin Formation assemblage in the study's reconstruction
ecology.locomotion: Treated as terrestrial in the cited comparison; locomotor performance was not directly tested
ecology.bodySize: Approximately 3 m in the study's reconstruction, with an immature femur-length estimate of 354–441 mm
ecology.guild: Top-tier terrestrial predator in the sampled Pekin Formation assemblage, as interpreted by the study

traits: NCSM 21558 preserves parts of the skull, vertebral column, ribs and left humerus
The reconstructed skull is slender and ornamented, with an estimated length greater than 50 cm
Premaxillary teeth are elongate, serrated and slightly recurved
evidenceSummary: The bones, Chatham County horizon and approximately 231 Ma age are direct records. Total length, predator role and crocodylomorph placement are study interpretations; tooth shape suggests faunivory but does not show feeding.

title.en: The named bones and their age
title.zh: 具名骨骼与年代

text.en: NCSM 21558 preserves parts of the skull, vertebral column, ribs and left humerus; NCSM 21623 is a referred humerus. The fossils come from the Pekin Formation in Chatham County, dated to about 231 Ma in the cited account.
text.zh: NCSM 21558 保存了部分头骨、脊柱、肋骨和左肱骨；NCSM 21623 是归入标本的一块肱骨。引文所述化石产自查塔姆县的 Pekin 组，年代约为 2.31 亿年前。

title.en: A predator reconstruction with limits
title.zh: 有边界的捕食者复原

text.en: Serrated, slightly recurved teeth support an inference of feeding on animal matter. Scaling from an immature femur produces an estimated length of about 3 m, and the study interprets Carnufex as a high-tier terrestrial predator in this assemblage. Neither the size estimate nor predator role is a direct observation of an adult animal hunting.
text.zh: 锯齿状、略向后弯的牙齿支持其取食动物性食物的推断。根据未成熟个体股骨进行尺度推算，体长约 3 米；研究据此将 Carnufex 解释为该化石群落中的高阶陆生捕食者。这些体型和生态判断都不是对成年个体捕猎行为的直接观察。

overviewZh: Carnufex carolinensis 由不完整、骨骼尚未成熟的正模 NCSM 21558，以及归入该种的一件肱骨 NCSM 21623 代表。研究重建其体长约为 3 m，并将其列入 Pekin 组化石组合中的较高阶陆生捕食者。
evidenceSummaryZh: 骨骼、Chatham County 的地层层位及约 231 Ma 的年代是直接记录。全长、捕食者角色和鳄形类位置属于研究解释；牙齿形态提示其食动物性，但不能证明其实际摄食。

overview: Holotype NHMM 2013 008 preserves a nearly complete three-dimensional skull with fragmentary postcranial bones from a 66.8–66.7 Ma Belgian horizon. Its cranial features combine galliform-like and anseriform-like states, but parsimony and tip-dated analyses disagree on its exact near-galloanseran position.

ecology.diet: The cited description does not resolve diet.
ecology.habitat: A littoral setting is possible from the marine deposits, but habitat preference is not directly observed.
ecology.locomotion: The cited description does not resolve locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: A skeletal-scaling model estimates a mean body mass of 394 g; this is not a direct weighing.
ecology.guild: No feeding or locomotor guild is assigned from these data.
ecology.dietZh: 所引描述未能确定食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 根据海相沉积，该化石可能来自滨海环境，但未直接观察到其生境偏好。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引描述没有确定其运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 骨骼尺度模型估计平均体重为 394 克；这并非直接称重结果。
ecology.guildZh: 这些数据未用于指定其摄食或运动生态类群。

traits: The type combines a nearly complete, three-dimensionally preserved skull with fragmentary postcranial elements.
The skull combines galliform-like and anseriform-like features in the authors’ comparison.
Parsimony and tip-dated Bayesian analyses recover different near-galloanseran placements.
evidenceSummary: The profile is limited to NHMM 2013 008, its 66.8–66.7 Ma horizon and a 394 g model estimate. Exact crown placement and a possible littoral ecology remain interpretation-dependent; this fossil does not establish the geographic origin of crown birds.
overviewZh: 正模 NHMM 2013 008 保存了近乎完整的三维颅骨及零碎的颅后骨骼，出自比利时一个 66.8–66.7 Ma 的层位。其颅骨兼有鸡形类样和雁形类样特征，但简约法与尖端定年分析对它在近鸡雁类中的确切位置得出了不同结果。
evidenceSummaryZh: 本页限于 NHMM 2013 008、其 66.8–66.7 Ma 层位和一个 394 g 的模型估计。其在冠群中的确切位置及可能的滨岸生态仍取决于解释；这件化石不能确定冠群鸟类的地理起源。

title.en: Field et al. (2020), Asteriornis holotype anatomy and competing phylogenetic analyses
title.zh: Field 等（2020），Asteriornis 正模解剖与竞争系统发育分析

scope.en: NHMM 2013 008 and its quarry/horizon provenance; Figures 1–3, Extended Data Figures 7–9 and the cited description. Existing research claims delimit anatomy, competing topology results, the skeletal-scaling mass estimate and tentative littoral interpretation. These locators do not establish a complete global range, feeding behaviour, flight performance, direct ancestry of this guide.
scope.zh: NHMM 2013 008 及其采石场和层位来源；图1–3、扩展数据图7–9及所引描述。既有研究 claims 限定解剖观察、竞争拓扑、骨骼尺度体重估计和暂定滨岸解释。这些定位不确立完整全球分布、取食行为、飞行性能、直系祖先关系。

title.en: A specimen from a constrained Belgian horizon
title.zh: 比利时限定层位中的具名标本

text.en: Holotype NHMM 2013 008 comes from the Maastricht Formation at the CBR-Romontbos quarry in Belgium. Field et al. (2020) constrain its source horizon to 66.8–66.7 Ma. This is a locality/horizon constraint, not the species’ complete duration or global first and last appearances. The collection number connects anatomy and phylogenetic interpretations to the same material; the locality does not identify the geographic origin of crown birds.
text.zh: 正模 NHMM 2013 008 出自比利时 CBR-Romontbos 采石场的 Maastricht 组。Field 等（2020）给出的6680万至6670万年前是该来源层位的年龄约束，不是本种完整存续期、全球首现或全球末现。馆藏号把后续解剖与系统发育解释连接到同一材料；出现地点也不确定冠群鸟类的地理起源。

title.en: What the fossil preserves
title.zh: 化石保存了什么

text.en: The specimen preserves a nearly complete three-dimensional skull with associated postcranial elements, studied through CT imaging and digital segmentation. In the authors’ comparison, its cranium combines galliform-like and anseriform-like features. These observations belong to the preserved material and comparison; the combination does not make it a modern chicken or duck or reveal unpreserved soft tissues and behaviour.
text.zh: 标本保存近完整、三维保存的头骨及相关头后骨骼，头骨经CT成像与数字分割研究。作者比较中，头骨呈现鸡形类样与雁形类样特征的组合。保存性状和比较结果是可限定到这件标本的证据；这种组合不表示它就是现代鸡或鸭，也不意味着未保存的软组织和行为已经确定。

title.en: Two analyses, two nearby placements
title.zh: 两种分析与两种相近位置

text.en: The study’s parsimony analysis recovered it as sister to crown Galloanserae. Its tip-dated Bayesian analysis instead placed it as the stemward-most member of Pangalliformes. Both concern its relationships near galloanserans, but they do not agree on the exact branch. This page reports the method-dependent results together; recorded database placement and atlas navigation do not independently resolve these competing results.
text.zh: 研究中的简约法把它恢复为冠群鸡雁类的姐妹群；尖端定年贝叶斯分析则把它放在全鸡形类最靠干群的位置。两项结果都关联近鸡雁类的比较，却并不一致地解决具体分支。本页并列报告这些方法依赖结果，数据库所录分类位置与图谱导航不能独立解决这些竞争结果。

title.en: A model estimate and a tentative habitat
title.zh: 模型体重与暂定环境解释

text.en: The reported mean body-mass estimate of 394 g is a skeletal-scaling model result, not a measured living animal. Small size and marine depositional context led the authors to suggest possible littoral ecology; burial setting does not directly establish habitat preference. The cited description does not resolve species-specific diet, locomotor performance or a feeding guild.
text.zh: 论文报告的平均体重估计为394克，是骨骼尺度模型结果，不是对活体的称量。小体型与海相沉积背景使作者提出可能的滨岸生态，但沉积地点不能直接证明动物的栖地偏好。所引描述没有确定本种食性、运动性能或摄食功能群；这里保持这些问题开放。

traitsZh: 正模兼有近乎完整、以三维形态保存的头骨和零碎的身体后部骨骼。
作者的比较显示，头骨兼具类似鸡形目和雁形目的特征。
简约法和尖端定年贝叶斯分析得出了不同的近鸡雁类位置。

readerLimitations.en: These sections are limited to NHMM 2013 008 and the description, comparisons and models in Field et al. (2020). A global range and first and last appearances remain unresolved for lack of sufficient provenance. Diet, flight or other locomotor performance, soft tissues and population variation remain unsupported in this batch. The horizon age does not close the range gap, and competing placements do not establish direct ancestry. This bilingual guide.
readerLimitations.zh: 四节限于正模NHMM 2013 008与Field等（2020）的描述、比较和模型。全球范围、最早与最晚出现仍缺少充分来源。食性、飞行或其他运动性能、软组织及群体变异缺乏本批可用证据。正文的层位年龄不解除这些范围缺口；两种系统位置也不确立直系祖先关系。。
